concerns.text: The functional requirement FR-001 (and several others) refer to “(See US-1)”, “(See US-2)”, “(See US-3)”. No identifiers named US‑1/US‑2/US‑3 exist in the document; the user stories are labeled “User Story 1”, “User Story 2”, etc. This broken cross‑reference makes traceability impossible.

The document mixes two naming conventions for user stories – the narrative headings use “User Story 1” while the FRs use the shorthand “US‑1”. Without a clear mapping, readers cannot determine which story each FR is tied to, causing a silent scope shift.

responses.response: Added explicit User Story IDs (US-1, US-2, US-3) and ensured all FR and SC cross‑references point to these IDs, restoring traceability.
responses.what_changed: Inserted '**User Story ID**: US-1/US-2/US-3' lines after each User Story heading; no other text altered.

responses.response: Standardized naming by defining US-1, US-2, US-3 identifiers and mapping each Functional Requirement to the appropriate User Story via those IDs.
responses.what_changed: Clarified mapping; FRs already used (See US‑X) which now resolve to defined IDs.
